ad: Detective Conan OVA 08: High School Girl Detective Sonoko Suzuki's Case Files
adEn: Meitantei Conan OVA 08: Joshikousei Tantei Suzuki Sonoko no Jikenbo
ozet: Sonoko is writing a script for a play. In her script, a murder case and high-school detective Suzuki Sonoko is there to help solve the case. Haibara finds flaws in the deduction section of the plot and Ran decides to call Shinichi for help with the script.
